title: Part A: Simulation of a simple calculator
description: Simulation of a Simple Calculator using switch case to perform basic arithmetic operations (+, -, *, /).

title: Part A: Compute quadratic equation roots
description: Compute the roots of a quadratic equation (ax^2 + bx + c = 0) handling real, equal, and complex roots.

title: Part A: Electricity bill calculation
description: An electricity board charges 80 paise/unit for first 200 units, 90 paise/unit for next 100 units, and Rs 1/unit beyond 300 units with Rs 100 minimum meter charge and 15% surcharge if total exceeds Rs 400.

title: Part A: Sine series Taylor expansion
description: Approximate the value of sin(x) using Taylor series expansion: sin(x) = x - x^3/3! + x^5/5! - ... and compare with math.h library function.

title: Part A: Binary search on sorted array
description: Implement Binary Search algorithm on an array of integers sorted in ascending order to find the key element and print its position.

title: Part A: Bubble sort algorithm
description: Sort a given set of N integer numbers in ascending order using the Bubble Sort algorithm and show the sorted array.

title: Part B: Matrix multiplication
description: Read two matrices A (m x n) and B (p x q) and compute the matrix multiplication product C = A x B if compatible, else display error message.

title: Part B: String operations without library functions
description: Write functions to implement string operations: string length, string copy, string concatenation, and string comparison without using library string functions.

title: Part B: Square root and pointer swapping
description: Compute the square root of a given number using Newton-Raphson method and swap two numbers using call by reference with pointers.

title: Part B: Maintain student records using structures
description: Maintain a record of N student details containing Name, USN, and Marks in 3 subjects using an array of structures. Compute the average marks and find students scoring above average.

title: Part B: Mean, variance and standard deviation with pointers
description: Develop a program using pointers to compute the sum, mean, variance and standard deviation of all elements in an array of n real numbers.

title: Part B: Right-rotate an array by k positions
description: Develop a program to right-rotate an integer array of N elements by k positions and print the rotated array.
